title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 5 — WORLD 10: B2 FINAL MASTERY & INDEPENDENT ENGLISH
description: The Grade 5 final world. A comprehensive B2 mastery environment where learners combine advanced vocabulary, grammar precision, extended comprehension, natural listening, sustained interaction, professional communication, argumentation, presentation and independent real-world problem solving.

targets.active_vocabulary: 2200+ words, collocations, phrasal verbs, idioms, academic-functional language and professional expressions
targets.reading: 1600–1800 words with inference, synthesis, tone, structure, purpose, evidence and vocabulary-in-context
targets.listening: 14–16 minutes of natural-speed multi-speaker English with accents, interruptions, reduced forms and implied meaning
targets.conversation: 20–25 minutes of sustained independent communication across unfamiliar topics
targets.writing: 400–500 words with coherent argument, counterargument, evidence, varied syntax and audience-aware register
targets.presentation: 8 minutes plus spontaneous audience questions and follow-up discussion
targets.real_life: professional, academic, travel, public-service, digital, customer-service, negotiation, emergency and social communication

missions.title: B2 Final Vocabulary Engine — Precision & Flexibility
missions.content: Activate a large B2 lexical network and choose precise words according to context, register, meaning, tone and communicative purpose.

missions.title: Grammar Command Center — B2 Accuracy Under Pressure
missions.content: Complete high-level editing and production tasks requiring accurate grammar choices in realistic extended communication rather than isolated drills.

missions.title: Meaning Mission — Modality, Certainty & Inference
missions.content: Infer what speakers and writers mean, distinguish certainty levels and justify conclusions from linguistic and contextual evidence.

missions.title: Conditional Mastery — Imagine, Evaluate & Rebuild
missions.content: Analyze choices and consequences across different time frames, express regrets and alternatives and rebuild hypothetical scenarios fluently.

missions.title: Sentence Architecture — From Simple Ideas to B2 Control
missions.content: Transform fragmented ideas into precise connected sentences, unpack dense language and reformulate complex information for different audiences.

missions.title: Information Mastery — Summarize, Report & Evaluate
missions.content: Process information from multiple sources, summarize accurately, attribute ideas and distinguish evidence from interpretation.

missions.title: Cohesion Mission — Build a Complete B2 Text
missions.content: Construct a connected multi-paragraph text in which ideas flow naturally through clear reference, linking and controlled repetition.

missions.title: Communication Intelligence — Tone, Nuance & Diplomacy
missions.content: Adjust language to different people and situations, disagree respectfully, soften difficult messages and repair misunderstandings without abandoning the conversation.

missions.title: Critical Information Lab — Compare, Verify & Conclude
missions.content: Compare written and spoken information, identify contradictions, evaluate evidence and produce a reasoned conclusion using precise language.

missions.title: Final Conversation Lab — Twenty-Five Minute Challenge
missions.content: Sustain a long unscripted conversation across multiple topics, introduce new ideas, respond to unexpected questions and keep interaction natural and purposeful.

missions.title: Reading Mastery — The Big B2 Investigation
missions.content: Read an extended investigation-style text and synthesize information across sections, infer unstated ideas and defend interpretations with evidence.

missions.title: Listening Mastery — Natural English Final Test
missions.content: Follow a demanding sequence of interviews, meetings, informal conversations and public announcements at natural speed, then reconstruct key information and speaker intentions.

missions.title: Writing Mastery — B2 Argument, Proposal & Response
missions.content: Produce a polished B2 text that identifies an issue, evaluates alternatives, supports recommendations, addresses objections and adapts tone to the intended reader.

missions.title: Presentation Mastery — Explain, Persuade & Defend
missions.content: Deliver a complete presentation on an unfamiliar topic, explain complex points clearly, defend a position and answer spontaneous audience questions.

missions.title: Real-Life Master Mission — Travel, Services & Public Situations
missions.content: Handle several connected real-world situations involving travel, appointments, customer service and public services while keeping communication clear, polite and efficient.

missions.title: Professional Master Mission — Workplace & Academic Communication
missions.content: Move from written instructions to discussion, decision-making, clarification, professional writing and a concrete action plan in one integrated simulation.

missions.title: Negotiation & Debate Mastery — Reach, Challenge & Defend
missions.content: Debate a difficult issue and negotiate a practical decision, responding to objections, making concessions and defending the final position with evidence.

missions.title: Ultimate Simulation — The Day Everything Changes
missions.content: Complete a long scenario in which travel, work, study, money, technology and communication problems appear unexpectedly. Explain decisions, adapt plans and maintain effective English throughout.

missions.title: Grade 5 Final Skills Marathon — B2 Under Real Conditions
missions.content: Complete the complete B2 skills circuit with limited preparation: lexical precision, grammar editing, extended reading, natural listening, spontaneous discussion, writing, presentation and negotiation.

missions.title: GRADE 5 FINAL MASTER QUEST — B2 INDEPENDENT ENGLISH
missions.content: The ultimate Grade 5 mission: combine advanced vocabulary, grammar precision, extended reading, natural listening, a sustained conversation, professional writing, presentation, debate, negotiation and a multi-stage crisis simulation. The learner must create language independently and adapt it to the situation rather than rely on translation or memorized answers.

final_mastery.communication_goal: Independent and flexible communication in familiar and unfamiliar everyday, academic and professional situations.
final_mastery.production_priority: Learners must explain, justify, compare, negotiate, summarize, infer, present and solve problems using their own English.
final_mastery.graduation_focus: Move from classroom English toward confident independent B2 communication.

quality_rules.progression: World 10 consolidates and tests the language developed throughout Grade 5 Worlds 1–9 while requiring greater independence, flexibility, speed and communicative control.
quality_rules.protected_note: This curriculum file adds Grade 5 World 10 only and does not modify Grade 2, Grade 3 or Grade 4.
